gates.detail: Pink Gum, Wirra and Stringybark are a test subset. Sitemap URL counts and the 2017 JSON are not campground counts.
Live parks.sa.gov.au HTML is not parsed. The matcher accepts structured fixtures only.
Pink Gum way/1192258723 is one camp. Its camp_pitch children are not camps. Geometry is not an entrance.
Current site CC BY 3.0 AU, legacy JSON CC BY 4.0 and OSM ODbL stay separate. Agency naming in the attribution form is unconfirmed. No booking prose or photos.
No dated CFS district values. Link-out only. A total fire ban is not a universal park closure.
Pink Gum's booking exception stays unknown. Wirra recurrence is tested on fixtures only. Chowilla and desert sites stay out of the pilot.
Segment is not created here. The variable must not enrol anyone until this gate and the token.js hold change together.
Foundation tests are not a substitute for a fresh VIC, NSW and QLD check at activation.
